dedupe_keys.name: copernicus seasonal forecast tools for climada

description: Copernicus Seasonal Forecast Tools is a Python package for preparing Copernicus seasonal forecasts for impact analysis. The JOSS paper describes accessing forecast fields, aggregating them, calculating heat indices and producing hazard objects that CLIMADA can read. The own repository identifies GPL-3.0 terms, so the package code is free. Inputs are seasonal forecasts, a region and selected heat measures. Outputs are processed fields or CLIMADA-compatible hazards. Geographic and temporal coverage follow the selected forecast product and lead time. Infrastructure planners could use seasonal heat scenarios to estimate pressure on buildings, power demand or emergency services. A caveat is that seasonal forecasts are probabilistic and may have limited skill for a local asset; they should be compared with observations and uncertainty retained. Copernicus access has separate service requirements and data terms. The existing catalogue record model-climada covers the downstream impact engine, not this preparation package. No data were downloaded or workflow executed.
